title: Juicy Golden Turkish Lamb Kebabs
description: A traditional Turkish dish featuring tender lamb, earthy spices, and a silky rice wine sauce, served in a unique agave leaf vessel. This keto-friendly recipe is perfect for a solo dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together rice wine, olive oil, garlic, paprika, cumin, salt, and pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes.
While the lamb is cooking, heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add a small amount of oil.
Remove the lamb from the oven and sear in the skillet for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Serve the lamb kebabs in agave leaf vessels, garnished with fresh parsley and lemon wedges.
